title: Aether resource manifest v1
description: Inventory only, not a promise of decoding or rendering. The byte parser additionally requires UTF-8, at most 1 MiB, depth at most 8, decoded strings at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no duplicate object keys or resource paths, and unsigned decimal integer lexemes for size_bytes (no sign, exponent or fraction). JSON Schema alone cannot enforce those byte and lexical rules.

path.description: Portable relative path, no empty, dot or dot-dot segments, trailing dots, drive, UNC, URI, percent escapes, backslashes or Windows device names (case-insensitive, including extensions). Path uniqueness is checked by the parser.
